mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_whatsapp_template ( tenant_id, template_name, language, category, status, rejection_reason, components, preview_url, last_sync_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{templateName}, #{language}, #{category}, #{status}, #{rejectionReason}, #{components}::jsonb, #{previewUrl}, #{lastSyncTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, template_name, language) DO UPDATE SET category = EXCLUDED.category, status = EXCLUDED.status, rejection_reason = EXCLUDED.rejection_reason, components = EXCLUDED.components, preview_url = EXCLUDED.preview_url, last_sync_time = EXCLUDED.last_sync_time, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_whatsapp_template SET status = #{status}, rejection_reason = COALESCE(#{rejectionReason}, rejection_reason), update_time = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_name = #{templateName} AND (#{language} IS NULL OR language = #{language})
